Recovering from nssock2.dll by Support
Published Mar 09, 2021

    Recovering from nssock2.dll by Support

    Mar 09, 2021

    Recovering from nssock2.dll

    Thursday, September 7, 2017 5:36 AM - Support

     

    As most of you know, July 18th's build of Xmanager was affected by malicious code in the nssock2.dll file.
    The announcement on the issue can be found here: https://www.netsarang.com/news/security_exploit_in_july_18_2017_build.html.
    A further progress report can be found here: https://www.netsarang.com/news/progress_report_of_the_nssock2_dll_backdoor.html

    Some users are having trouble re-installing Xmanager after their antivirus has quarantined the affected dll file, nssock2.dll. If you're having issues reinstalling, please use the following steps.

    1. Allow your antivirus to delete the quarantined nssock2.dll file.
    2. Reinstall Xmanager using the latest Build which can be found on our website here: https://www.netsarang.com/download/software.html
    3. If you are using other NetSarang products, you may need to uninstall all of them before you can re-install Xmanager successfully.

    Please contact our support team with any issues at support@netsarang.com
